doubts.claim_under_doubt: every non-ready pending row carries an accurate blocked_by reason
doubts.disproof_attempt: ready_unit_ids and _dep_blocker each ran ancestry with separate git I/O; a ref moving or a timeout between the two passes yields ready=false with blocked_by=[].
doubts.resolution: fixed: one verdict per unit (unit_blockers); test patches _is_ancestor side_effect=[False, False, True, True, True] and asserts ready != bool(blocked_by) for every row

doubts.claim_under_doubt: readiness is cheap, read-only and fit for polling
doubts.disproof_attempt: Fetch amplification (1+2K fetches) and serial base resolution fetching even for a finalized campaign.
doubts.resolution: fixed: at most one fetch per call, memoized per commit; finalized campaigns skip base resolution (test pins it); module docstring states readiness does network I/O and must not be polled tightly

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the frozen fixture guards the versioned contract
doubts.disproof_attempt: reason vocabulary only typed as string; fixture hard-coded to 1.0.
doubts.resolution: fixed: enums.blocked_by.reason pinned and compared to REASONS; fixture path derived from READINESS_SCHEMA_VERSION. Rebuttal for the remainder: origin/main git-baseline enforcement (contract_baseline) is a follow-up, same as the code-review note

doubts.disproof_attempt: malformed sub_iterate state raised an uncaught KeyError traceback.
doubts.resolution: fixed: structured malformed_state error, exit 1, tested

summary: 2 medium, 2 low doubts; no high. Core claim holds; all addressed.
